research.notes: BrightPath Health sells patient-scheduling and intake software to outpatient clinics (~900 employees, Boston). A job posting for 'Salesforce Administrator, CRM Migration' (2026-10) says the company is moving its sales org from HubSpot to Salesforce in Q1 2027. A press release on 2026-08-04 announced Elena Ortiz as Chief Revenue Officer. Marcus Lee has led Revenue Operations since 2023 and his LinkedIn profile lists 'pipeline governance' and 'forecast cadence' as focus areas. No funding news in the last 6 months.

drafts.subject: pipeline hygiene mid-migration
drafts.body:
Hi Marcus,

Saw BrightPath is hiring a Salesforce admin for the HubSpot move in Q1. Migrations are usually when deal data gets messiest, right as a new CRO is asking how much of the forecast to trust.

Pipewise sits on top of either CRM and flags deals going stale from activity and call notes, so your forecast cadence doesn't depend on reps updating fields mid-move. Setup is under a day on Salesforce or HubSpot.

Would it help to have that running before cutover, or after?

Sam Patel
Pipewise
drafts.angle: CRM migration plus new CRO makes forecast trust fragile; Pipewise works across both CRMs.
